summary: Humacyte, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting clinical trial results for its ATEV in female dialysis patients and an investor presentation. The filing is a routine current report on business updates, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or capital event is disclosed. The press release details positive Phase 3 data and plans for a supplemental BLA filing. There are no deal terms, advisor mentions, or structural changes. This is a standard operational update with no special-situations trigger.
